findings.summary: The tuition-fee and tuition-term controls are presented as independently optional, but validation requires both or neither, so their relationship is not conveyed before submission.
findings.fix: Group the native selects in a fieldset with a legend such as “Tuition assignment (optional)” and add visible instructions: “Select both fields or leave both blank.” Keep each select’s individual label.
findings.evidence: Both fields are configured as optional; validation rejects selecting only one.
